climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Shiraz and Cabernet Sauvignon sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: A Victorian region in the Central Victoria zone, with vineyards since 1860. Tahbilk still makes wine from vines planted in the 1860s, and sandy soil kept phylloxera out. Shiraz is 29 percent of plantings, and Nagambie Lakes lies inside.
